files.summary: Maven build for event-marketplace-api 0.0.1-SNAPSHOT on Spring Boot 3.3.4, Java 21. Declares web, validation, data-jpa, security, PostgreSQL runtime, hibernate-spatial plus jts-core 1.19.0 for PostGIS, jjwt-api/impl/jackson 0.12.6, Lombok, starter-test and security-test. Used by Maven/Spring Boot plugin to build runnable API jar.

Auth REST controller (thin, no business logic): POST register (201, 409 duplicate, 400 validation, 429 rate-limit), POST login (200, 401 generic, 429), GET me via @AuthenticationPrincipal (401 unauthenticated), POST logout stateless success. Handlers wrap validation and rate-limit errors in ApiResponse envelope; no stack traces leak.

Login DTO: email @Email @NotBlank @Size max 254, password @NotBlank @Size max 72 (BCrypt 72-byte limit). Password is never trimmed or modified server-side; validation failures map to 400 via controller handler.

Auth result DTO with token, userId UUID, email, fullName, Role role, vendorId UUID. Lombok @Data/@Builder. Returned by AuthService register/login/getMe and serialized inside ApiResponse by AuthController.

Registration DTO: email max 254, password 6-72 chars, fullName max 100, phone max 20; role CUSTOMER/VENDOR and optional vendor fields (businessName, category, address, geo, pricing). Service rejects ADMIN roles.

Auth business logic: normalizes email (lowercase/trim) for lookup, exists-check and save; BCrypt encode on register and matches on login; duplicate email throws IllegalStateException without echo (409, plus TOCTOU DataIntegrityViolation catch); login failures generic 401; IP+email sliding-window rate limit throws 429; issues JWT with vendorId resolution; getMe returns safe profile without token.

In-memory sliding-window rate limiter @Component for auth endpoints keyed by client IP + normalized email (X-Forwarded-For aware). Configurable max-attempts (default 10) and window-ms (default 5 min) via app.auth.rate-limit; ConcurrentHashMap with per-key deque pruning; never blocks on IP-resolution failure.

CommandLineRunner Component that skips if userRepository.count>0, else seeds customer@example.com/password123 Sarah Jenkins and 7 Bangalore vendors (DJ, PHOTOGRAPHER, CATERER, DECORATOR, VENUE, SOUND_LIGHTING, EMCEE) with coordinates, prices, ratings and PortfolioItems. Runs automatically on Spring Boot startup.

Generic envelope with success boolean, message, data T, timestamp Instant default now. Static helpers success(message,data), success(data), error(message). Used by all controllers for uniform JSON responses.

OncePerRequestFilter Bearer parser: skips non-Bearer chains, extracts sub email, reloads User from DB, validates signature+expiry, rebuilds ROLE_ authority from DB (ignores token role claim), sets User entity as principal; failures logged at debug with exception type only, never the token.

JWT issuer/verifier (JJWT 0.12.6): secret from env only with ephemeral random dev fallback and 256-bit Base64 validation (no committed default); configurable 8h expiry; minimal claims userId and role with sub=email (fullName removed); parser verifyWith enforces signature; expiry checked on validation.

Stateless security: explicit public POST login/register and GET vendors only, rest authenticated; JSON 401 entry point and 403 denied handler; CORS allowlist from app.cors.allowed-origins with credentials and maxAge; headers CSP default-self, deny frame, content-type options, strict referrer, HSTS; CSRF disabled and documented as Bearer-only; BCrypt strength 12.

Spring Boot entrypoint annotated @SpringBootApplication in package com.eventpulse enabling component scan for auth, config, common and JPA. Main method calls SpringApplication.run. Triggers DataSeeder and filter chain at startup.

REST controller for /api/inquiries, thin HTTP layer delegating to InquiryService (no business logic, never touches repositories). POST requires CUSTOMER role with JWT principal identity (no spoofable customerId), @Valid InquiryRequest, returns 201 with Booking request sent successfully. GET /my-inquiries restricted to CUSTOMER; GET /{id} ownership enforced in service; vendor inbox/status require VENDOR. Local handlers map validation failures to 400, AccessDeniedException to generic 403, ResponseStatusException to its status — all in ApiResponse envelope, no stack traces.

Validated create-booking DTO for POST /api/inquiries. Requires vendorId UUID, eventType NotBlank, eventDate NotNull FutureOrPresent, customerName/Email NotBlank, message NotBlank. Optional guestCount, budget, customerPhone. Defaults to User fullName/email/phone in service if null.

Read DTO for inquiries. Contains id, customerId, vendorId, vendorBusinessName/category/coverImage/contactEmail/phone (contact gated to ACCEPTED/COMPLETED), eventType/date/guestCount/budget, customerName/email/phone, message, status, vendorNotes, createdAt. Built by InquiryServiceImpl.mapToResponse.

DTO for PATCH /api/inquiries/{id}/status: status @NotNull (PENDING to ACCEPTED/DECLINED, ACCEPTED to COMPLETED transitions enforced in InquiryServiceImpl, violations map to 409); vendorNotes @Size max 2000. Validated via @Valid in controller; safe generic error envelope on failure.

JPA @Entity inquiries with UUID id, lazy ManyToOne User customer and VendorProfile vendor both not null, eventType/eventDate required, guestCount, budget, customerName/email/phone snapshots, message length 2000, status enum default PENDING, vendorNotes, createdAt/updatedAt timestamps.

Four-state booking lifecycle enum persisted as STRING in Inquiry.status. Values PENDING, ACCEPTED, DECLINED, COMPLETED. Transitions enforced in InquiryServiceImpl.isValidTransition: PENDING to ACCEPTED/DECLINED, ACCEPTED to COMPLETED only.

JpaRepository<Inquiry,UUID> with derived ordered queries findByCustomerIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc, findByVendorIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc, findByVendorIdAndStatusOrderByCreatedAtDesc. Used for customer history and vendor inbox feeds sorted newest first.

@Service @Transactional logic: createInquiry 404s missing vendor and rejects unavailable vendors, getInquiryById enforces customer-or-vendor ownership, updateInquiryStatus enforces vendor ownership plus isValidTransition state machine, mapToResponse hides vendor contact via isContactVisible unless ACCEPTED/COMPLETED.

Interface with 5 methods: createInquiry, getCustomerInquiries, getInquiryById, getVendorInquiries, updateInquiryStatus. Implemented by InquiryServiceImpl and called by InquiryController for customer and vendor flows.

Three-value role enum persisted as STRING in User.role default CUSTOMER. Values CUSTOMER, VENDOR, ADMIN. Drives @PreAuthorize hasRole checks in VendorPortalController and InquiryController and inquiry ownership logic.

JPA @Entity users with UUID id, unique email, password, fullName required, phone optional, Role enum default CUSTOMER, createdAt/updatedAt. Injected directly as @AuthenticationPrincipal in vendor and inquiry controllers; linked OneToOne from VendorProfile and ManyToOne from Inquiry.
JpaRepository<User,UUID> with findByEmail returning Optional and existsByEmail boolean. Supports authentication lookup and registration uniqueness checks for User entity.

Public read-only REST controller at /api/vendors delegating to VendorService. GET /search, /count-nearby, /{id} (404 on unknown id), /all fallback. Masks vendor contactPhone/contactEmail to null on all public responses. Wraps results in ApiResponse.

Vendor self-service REST controller at /api/vendor-portal guarded by hasRole('VENDOR'). Uses @AuthenticationPrincipal User. Exposes GET /profile, PUT /profile with @Valid VendorProfileUpdateRequest, PATCH /availability toggle, POST /portfolio and DELETE /portfolio/{itemId}. Delegates to VendorService. Called by vendor dashboard.

Spring Data interface projection for native GROUP BY category count query. Exposes getCategory String and getCount Long. Returned by VendorProfileRepository.countNearbyByCategory and aggregated into NearbyCountSummaryDto.byCategory in VendorServiceImpl.countNearby.

Lombok @Data @Builder response DTO for GET /api/vendors/count-nearby. Fields total long, radiusKm double, byCategory Map<String,Long> default empty. Built in VendorServiceImpl.countNearby with zero-filled entries for all VendorCategory values.

Lombok @Data @Builder DTO for portfolio images. Fields id UUID, imageUrl, title, description, sortOrder Integer. Used as request/response in POST /api/vendor-portal/portfolio, embedded list in VendorDetailDto, and mapped from PortfolioItem entity.

Lombok list-card DTO for search results. Fields id, businessName, category, description, addressLine, city, state, latitude, longitude, startingPrice, priceUnit, ratingAvg, reviewCount, coverImageUrl, contactPhone/Email, isAvailable, serviceRadiusKm, distanceKm. Built from VendorDistanceProjection or VendorProfile.

Lombok detail DTO for GET /api/vendors/{id} and portal profile. Extends VendorCardDto fields plus postalCode and portfolioItems List<PortfolioItemDto> default empty. Built in VendorServiceImpl.getVendorDetail with Java Haversine distance rounding and sortOrder-sorted portfolio.

Spring Data interface projection for native Haversine search query. Getters for id, businessName, category, description, addressLine, city, state, latitude, longitude, startingPrice, priceUnit, ratingAvg, reviewCount, coverImageUrl, contactPhone/Email, isAvailable, serviceRadiusKm, distanceKm. Maps snake_case aliases.

Validated @Data @Builder request for PUT /api/vendor-portal/profile. Requires @NotBlank businessName and @NotNull VendorCategory category. Optional description, addressLine, city, state, postalCode, latitude, longitude, serviceRadiusKm, startingPrice, priceUnit, isAvailable, coverImageUrl, contactPhone/Email.

JPA @Entity portfolio_items with UUID id, lazy @ManyToOne VendorProfile vendor join vendor_id not null @JsonIgnore, imageUrl not null length 1000, title, description, sortOrder default 0. Owned cascade ALL orphanRemoval from VendorProfile.

Enum of 8 vendor categories persisted as STRING in VendorProfile.category and queried as String filter in native search. Values DJ, PHOTOGRAPHER, CATERER, DECORATOR, VENUE, SOUND_LIGHTING, MAKEUP_ARTIST, EMCEE. Normalized uppercase in VendorServiceImpl search.

JPA @Entity vendor_profiles with UUID id, lazy @OneToOne User user unique not null, businessName, VendorCategory enum, description 2000, addressLine/city/state/postalCode, latitude/longitude Double, serviceRadiusKm default 25, startingPrice, priceUnit default per event, isAvailable default true, ratingAvg default 4.8, reviewCount default 0, cover/contact fields, cascade portfolioItems, timestamps, updateCoordinates helper.

Spring Data JpaRepository<PortfolioItem,UUID> with single derived query findByVendorIdOrderBySortOrderAsc for ordered portfolio fetch. Used indirectly via VendorProfile.portfolioItems; direct delete/fetch in VendorServiceImpl add/remove portfolio flows.

JpaRepository<VendorProfile,UUID> with findByUserId, findByCategory, plus two native queries using 6371*acos Haversine: searchNearestVendors(lat,lng,radiusKm,category) filtering is_available and non-null coords ordered by distanceKm returning VendorDistanceProjection, and countNearbyByCategory grouped counts returning CategoryCountProjection.

@Service @Transactional implementation mapping projections/entities to DTOs. Normalizes ALL/blank category to null, aggregates counts with zero-fill, computes Java Haversine calculateDistance for detail, sorts portfolio by sortOrder, enforces portfolio ownership on delete, filters available vendors in fallback with distance 0.0.

Service interface defining 9 operations: searchNearestVendors, countNearby, getVendorDetail, getVendorProfileForUser, updateVendorProfile, toggleAvailability, addPortfolioItem, removePortfolioItem, getAllVendorsFallback. Implemented by VendorServiceImpl, called by VendorDiscoveryController and VendorPortalController.

App config: server port, PostgreSQL datasource and ddl-auto update from env; app.jwt.secret requires JWT_SECRET with no committed default; 8h token expiry configurable; auth rate-limit attempts/window configurable; CORS origins env-configurable; Hibernate Postgres dialect.

Authenticated booking-request form for a vendor. Fetches vendor header via getVendorDetail GET /api/vendors/:id with optional lat/lng query, prefills customerName/email from useAuth, validates eventType, eventDate, guestCount, budget, message, then submitInquiry POST /api/inquiries. Handles not-found/error states, availability gate, and success card linking to /my-inquiries. Uses Navbar, Button, Input, Select, Textarea, Card, Badge.

Root layout for all routes. Sets HTML lang, Geist sans/mono font variables, global metadata (EventPulse title/description), viewport themeColor, Leaflet 1.9.4 CSS link, and body shell with background/foreground styles rendering children. Purely static server component wrapper, no state or API calls.

Login screen with email and password fields, show/hide password toggle, loading button, alert error region, register link, and redirect-if-authenticated by role. Dev-only demo quick-login buttons (customer/vendor seed accounts) gated by SHOW_DEMO_LOGINS, hidden in production unless NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_DEMO_LOGINS=true. No token or password logging.

Customer single inquiry detail with progress tracker. Auth-guarded, loads via getInquiryById GET /api/inquiries/:id. Shows vendorBusinessName, status badge, event details, customer request, vendorNotes, and vendor contact card revealing tel:/mailto: plus copy-phone only when accepted. Builds Submitted/Accepted/Completed steps. Uses Navbar, Card, Badge, Skeleton, DetailRow.

Customer inquiry list requiring login. Guards via useAuth and redirects to /login, fetches via getCustomerInquiries GET /api/inquiries/my-inquiries. Renders vendorBusinessName, category, eventType, eventDate, guestCount, budget, message with STATUS_MAP for PENDING/ACCEPTED/DECLINED/COMPLETED badges, tel: link only after accept, and details link to /my-inquiries/[id]. Uses Navbar, Card, Badge, Skeleton.

Marketplace explorer home: GPS detect plus preset/custom coordinates, 5-50km radius slider, category pills with live counts, text search, available-only filter, nearest-first vendor cards with skeletons and empty state, split list/map layout with mobile toggle, auth-aware header (login/register or portal links plus logout). Uses useAuth for display only; no credential handling.

Dual customer/vendor registration screen. Holds accountType CUSTOMER|VENDOR plus formData with fullName, email, password, phone and vendor businessName, category, city, startingPrice, serviceRadiusKm, description with default Bangalore lat/lng. Calls useAuth register() via POST /api/auth/register, redirects VENDOR to /vendor else /. Uses Navbar, Button, Input, Select, Textarea, Field, Card.

Suspense-wrapped vendor booking detail. Cards: Customer (mailto:/tel: links + message), Event Details (type/date/guests/budget/received via DetailRow), Vendor Notes (saved through updateInquiryStatus with unchanged status, notesDirty-gated Save button). Status sidebar: PENDING shows Accept/Decline, ACCEPTED shows Mark Completed, DECLINED/COMPLETED show terminal messages; uses textarea notes or defaults like 'Accepted via dashboard'. DetailSkeleton fallback, back-to-bookings error card.

Vendor bookings list with status filter pills (FILTERS ALL/PENDING/ACCEPTED/DECLINED/COMPLETED with live counts) â€” no search box. Loads via getVendorInbox; inline Accept/Decline on PENDING rows with optimistic update, snapshot rollback and per-row errors, default notes 'Accepted via dashboard'/'Declined â€” unavailable'. STATUS_MAP badges, guest/budget/message meta, links to /vendor/bookings/[id]. Empty and per-filter empty states with retry.

Vendor dashboard hub. Loads profile + inbox in parallel (Promise.all getMyProfile/getVendorInbox). Optimistic availability toggle button (aria-pressed, 'Open for Bookings' vs 'Paused â€” Fully Booked') with server-truth sync and rollback on error. Stat cards (total/pending/accepted/completed), 5 most-recent leads with STATUS_MAP badges linking to /vendor/bookings/[id]. No inline accept/decline here. Category Badge, UTC formatEventDate, skeleton/error/retry states.

Vendor photo portfolio manager. Vendor-guarded, loads items via getMyProfile GET /api/vendor-portal/profile, adds via addPortfolioItem POST /api/vendor-portal/portfolio with URL-regex plus required-title validation and sortOrder defaulting to items.length, deletes via deletePortfolioItem DELETE /api/vendor-portal/portfolio/:itemId with two-step confirm then server reload. Grid sorted by sortOrder with image error-hiding; empty, error and retry states. Uses Navbar, VendorNav, Button, Card, Input, Textarea, Label, Skeleton.

Vendor business profile editor. Vendor-guarded, loads via getMyProfile GET /api/vendor-portal/profile into typed ProfileForm via toForm(), saves via updateMyProfile PUT /api/vendor-portal/profile with businessName/category required plus email/URL/price/radius validation. Generic field() render helper, CATEGORIES const (8 values), geolocation Use-my-location with fallback error, LocationPicker (value/onChange API) via dynamic SSR-off import, availability shown as read-only Badge managed from Dashboard. Uses Navbar, VendorNav, Button, Card, Badge, Input, Select, Textarea.

Public vendor profile detail page. Reads vendorId param plus lat/lng search params, loads via getVendorDetail GET /api/vendors/:id, shows cover image, category, availability badge, address, distanceKm, ratingAvg, startingPrice, serviceRadiusKm, description, portfolioItems grid, and sticky Price Summary card with Send Booking Request link to /book/[vendorId]. Includes skeleton and not-found states. Uses Navbar, Badge, Card, Skeleton.

Client click-to-set location picker on the MapLibre wrapper. Props: value {lat,lng} (LocationPickerValue), onChange, optional className. Internal MapInteractions subscribes to map click events via useMap and renders a MapMarker pin; coordinate readout with Clear button resetting to null. Defaults center to Bangalore [77.5946,12.9716], zoom 14 when set. Imports cn from @/lib/utils. Consumed by vendor profile page via dynamic SSR-off import.

Small pill status label. Exports BadgeVariant (neutral|success|warning|danger|info) and Badge component with props variant, dot, className, children using cn and variantClasses hex styles. Consumed across vendor/inquiry UIs for status indicators.

Shared button primitive with loading state. Exports ButtonVariant (primary|secondary|ghost|danger|link), ButtonSize (sm|md|lg), ButtonProps (variant,size,loading) and Button using Loader2 spinner, cn, variantClasses/sizeClasses. Consumed widely e.g. Navbar logout action.
Minimal white card containers. Exports Card with hover prop for shadow-card-hover, CardTitle (h3), CardDescription (p muted) all using cn. Consumed for panels and list items throughout frontend.

Styled form field primitives sharing fieldClasses. Exports Input, Textarea, Select, Label, Field (label, htmlFor, hint, children). Uses hairline shadow and focus-ring styles via cn. Consumed by login, register, inquiry and vendor profile forms.

MapLibre-GL React wrapper with OSM raster style. Exports Map (center,zoom,pitch,bearing,mapStyle,className,interactive), MapMarker (longitude,latitude,onClick), MarkerContent, MarkerTooltip, MarkerPopup, hooks useMap/useMarker and MapContext/MarkerContext via portals. DEFAULT_MAP_STYLE uses tile.openstreetmap.org. Consumed by LocationPicker.
Loading placeholders. Exports Skeleton div with skeleton class and Spinner span with role=status, configurable label, CSS spin border. Consumed for loading states in lists and detail pages.

Leaflet vendor map (SSR-off): OSM tiles, customer origin marker with radius circle, emoji category pins with price pills, rich popups exposing only public vendor info, selection sync and fit-bounds. No auth or private contact data rendered.

Client tab bar for vendor portal. Default export VendorNav with TABS constant for /vendor, /vendor/bookings, /vendor/profile, /vendor/portfolio. Uses usePathname and cn to highlight active tab via exact or prefix match and aria-current. Consumed on vendor pages as secondary navigation.

Session hook over localStorage key eventpulse_user_session: validates stored shape (token, email, known role) on load and discards corrupt data; login/register persist session; logout calls backend logout best-effort then clears. Exposes token, isAuthenticated, isVendor/isCustomer flags.

Shared cn() class-name merger (clsx + tailwind-merge), standard shadcn convention. Imported by LocationPicker, VendorNav, all ui/* primitives and several pages (12 importers). Only 6 lines; never inline or duplicate this helper.

Next.js frontend manifest name frontend 0.1.0 private with scripts dev/build/start/lint (next dev, next build, next start, eslint). Dependencies: next 16.4.0, react 19.3.0, react-dom 19.3.0, leaflet 1.9.4, maplibre-gl 6.13.0, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge, Geist font; dev: tailwindcss 4, typescript 5, eslint 9.

Fetch wrappers with API_BASE from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL env (fallback http://localhost:8080/api). Every response unwraps the ApiResponse envelope (data.data); GETs use cache:no-store. Covers searchVendors, countNearby, getVendorDetail, loginUser, registerUser, submitInquiry, getCustomerInquiries, getInquiryById (explicit 404/403 errors), getVendorInbox, updateInquiryStatus(id,status,notes,token), toggleVendorAvailability, getMyProfile/updateMyProfile, add/deletePortfolioItem, plus getVendorProfile/updateVendorProfile aliases.

Auth API client using NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL with localhost fallback: loginApi, registerApi, getMeApi (Bearer, reattaches token) and best-effort logoutApi. Throws Error with server message; stores no secrets and logs nothing sensitive.
